decisions.reason: The existing message-146 MODIFY already states that the founder receives $4 per sale and the remainder funds commissions and prize pools.
Changing the allocation of secondary-sale royalty proceeds does not alter which NFT attributes or active tickets transfer to a secondary buyer.
The royalty-proceeds allocation does not change the Base network requirement.
The royalty-proceeds allocation does not change the NFT ebook asset type, unlimited supply model, mint price, or edition identifier.
The Small Block state already requires ongoing funding from secondary-sale royalties; the source preserves that fact and does not specify a new Small Block allocation or draw rule.
The Big Block state already requires ongoing funding from secondary-sale royalties; the source preserves that fact and does not change its prize or draw parameters.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already captures the $4 founder allocation, applicable fiat fees, commission allocation, and remaining primary-sale proceeds funding the prize pools.
Allocation of secondary-sale royalty proceeds does not change Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, transfer, weighting, or reset behavior.
The royalty-proceeds allocation does not change Chainlink VRF selection, eligible ticket holders, fairness, or on-chain verification.
Allocation of secondary-sale royalty proceeds does not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, transfer, weighting, or reset behavior.
The royalty-proceeds allocation does not change wallet requirements for fiat minting, commissions, prize tickets, or secondary trading.
The royalty-proceeds allocation does not change any NFT metadata counter, badge, or referral-code attribute.
